annotations.title: Create a site from raw HTML

description: BUILD FIRST. Creates a live draft site from HTML you already have - free, instant, no account and no sign-in, fully deterministic with no language model involved. Call it immediately when the user brings you markup, then show them the returned preview_url. Choose create_site_from_brief instead when you are authoring the site yourself and want every section to stay editable in the Pagetool editor: this route keeps the markup verbatim and the flattening is ONE-WAY. Both routes end in the same hosted, publishable site. Scripts, event handlers and javascript: links are always stripped, and external, data: and framework-internal image URLs are dropped and reported back to you. You can edit or claim this draft for 7 days from creation.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

html.description: The raw HTML to import. A full document or a bare fragment/section both work. Max 2 MB. Include the page CSS in a <style> block - inline and <style> CSS are mapped to the site styling; external stylesheet links are not fetched. To build several pages at once, pass pages instead.

pages.description: Build a whole site in one call instead of html: a list of up to 10 pages, each { path, html, name? }, exactly one with path "/" (the home page), e.g. [{"path":"/","html":"..."},{"path":"/about","html":"..."}]. Link between pages with href="/about". Every page is checked before anything is created.

site_name.description: Optional display name for the site (defaults to the document title, or "Imported site").
